stops.name: Kleifarvatn
stops.detail: Kleifarvatn is a lake on the Icelandic Reykjanes Peninsula.

stops.name: Sveifluháls
stops.detail: Mountains frame the lake on all sides, including the 407-meter-high palagonite ridge Sveifluháls in the west.

stops.name: Krýsuvík
stops.detail: The area around Kleifarvatn is characterized by the active volcanoes surrounding it; it itself lies in the middle of the Krýsuvík volcanic system.

stops.name: Seltún
stops.detail: Two high-temperature areas are located near the lake, one at Seltún (see image at Reykjanesskagi), another in the east of the lake.

stops.name: Krísuvíkurkirkjan
stops.detail: The small church Krísuvíkurkirkjan is the only building of the hamlet still standing to the southwest of the lake; it is a listed building and is now maintained by the National Museum Þjóðminjasafn in Reykjavík.
